titel: TWiV 1354: Clinical update with Dr. Daniel Griffin

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen: keine Merkmale gefunden, aber eine unveraenderte Wiederholungsprobe beweist nichts

einzeiler: Clinical insights on measles, long COVID trials, and vaccine-preventable cardiovascular…
kurzfassung: Dr. Daniel Griffin breaks down the latest clinical data, including a massive long COVID trial and research showing cardiovascular benefits from the shingles vaccine. The episode also covers rising public health concerns surrounding measles outbreaks and recent policy controversies. Listeners submit questions regarding post-exposure treatments, pediatric COVID vaccinations, and managing immunosuppressive therapies.
stichpunkte: Discussion of Dolly Parton's historical support for vaccination and public health advocacy
Analysis of a Nature Medicine study showing a 9% decrease in cardiovascular burden following the recombinant shingles vaccine
Updates on the ongoing Bundibugyo virus Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
Examination of measles outbreaks, rising case numbers, and debates over reporting data
Review of an airborne virus transmission review highlighting the complexity of indoor environments
Results from a large clinical trial showing no evidence of benefit from Paxlovid in long COVID patients
Listener Q&A addressing timing for restarting immunosuppressive therapy after a COVID infection
Evaluation of zocuvir for post-COVID exposure prevention and considerations for pediatric COVID vaccination

clips.hook: Public figures misleading the public for power and profit
clips.text: The hosts discuss how political figures intentionally spread misinformation to achieve specific outcomes and personal gain.

clips.hook: Shingles vaccine tied to a drop in heart disease risk
clips.text: Recent research reveals a notable reduction in cardiovascular events over a seven-year period following vaccination.

clips.hook: A measles mortality rate much higher than expected
clips.text: The current outbreak demonstrates a significantly increased death-to-case ratio compared to historical averages.

clips.hook: The steep financial cost of containing tiny measles clusters
clips.text: A small number of cases requires thousands of hours of public health labor and hundreds of thousands of dollars to manage.

clips.hook: Paxlovid shows no benefit in treating long COVID
clips.text: A large, randomized controlled trial finds no therapeutic effect from the antiviral across multiple long COVID symptom types.

beschreibung:
In his weekly clinical update, Daniel Griffin and Vincent Racaniello remember Dolly Parton and her patronage of science, especially development of the COVID-19 vaccines, if the shingles vaccine protect against cardiovascular events as well as dementia, the continued national cyclosporiasis and screwworm outbreaks, size of the Ebola outbreak in the Congo, the death of 2 children in Pennsylvania from measles and the economic cost of the measles outbreak, before Dr. Griffin deep dives into how to determine the case fatality rate of measles as well as measles outbreaks, recent statistics RSV, influenza, SARS-CoV-2 infections, approval of new mRNA COVID-19 vaccines by the FDA, access and how pay for Paxlovid, where to go for answers about long COVID-19, clinical guidelines for treating long COVID, B-cells-autoimmunity- long COVID, enrolling in a long COVID trial and the use of the COVID antiviral drug to "sop up" chronic virus shedding and contacting your federal government representative to stop the assault on science and biomedical research.
